metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2002 · Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
metas.description: Harry Potter lives his second year at Hogwarts with Ron and Hermione when a message on the wall announces that the legendary Chamber of Secrets has been opened. The trio soon realize that, to save the school, it will take a lot of...

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2007 · Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
metas.description: With their warning about Lord Voldemort's return scoffed at, Harry and Dumbledore are targeted by the Wizard authorities as an authoritarian bureaucrat slowly seizes power at Hogwarts.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2003 · Elf
metas.description: A man raised by Santa's elves travels from the North Pole to New York City to meet his biological father, who doesn't know he exists and is in desperate need of some Christmas spirit.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2007 · Bridge to Terabithia
metas.description: Leslie and Jess create the secret kingdom of Terabithia, a land of monsters, trolls, ogres and giants where they spend their free time ruling as king and queen and fighting evil creatures.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2008 · Marley & Me
metas.description: A family learns important life lessons from their adorable, but naughty and neurotic dog.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2009 · My Sister's Keeper
metas.description: Anna Fitzgerald looks to earn medical emancipation from her parents who until now have relied on their youngest child to help their leukemia-stricken daughter Kate remain alive.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2006 · Eight Below
metas.description: Brutal cold forces two Antarctic explorers to leave their team of sled dogs behind as they fend for their survival.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2007 · 5 Centimeters per Second
metas.description: Told in three interconnected segments, Takaki tells the story of his life as cruel winters, cold technology, and finally, adult obligations and responsibility converge to test the delicate petals of love.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2003 · Secondhand Lions
metas.description: Fourteen-year-old Walter Caldwell's irresponsible mother Mae sends him to live with his bachelor uncles, Hub and Garth, so that she can go on yet another husband-hunting trip.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2005 · March of the Penguins
metas.description: In the Antarctic, every March since the beginning of time, the quest begins to find the perfect mate and start a family.
